title: Mayamora Buranji
author: Shrikumar Dohutia
genre: Socio-Religious & Political History of Upper Assam
description: Comprehensive historical investigation published in Tinsukia by Shrikumar Dohutia examining the origins, monastic institutions, spiritual philosophy of Sri Sri Aniruddhadeva, and the profound social convulsions of the Mayamora (Moamaria) rebellion against Ahom centralization in the 18th century across Dibrugarh and Tinsukia.
